history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration conduct reviews and analyses of audit findings on a regular basis and take concrete and proactive action to address widespread and recurring issues, with a view to avoiding any systematic risk therein.
history.administration_response: Management requests that this recommendation be closed. With the issuance of the new global guidelines for country-based pooled funds in December 2022, provisions have been made to better deal with recurring critical risk findings for individual partners and to analyse key audit findings at the fund level to identify concrete actions (see chapters 5 and 6 of the guidelines).
history.board_assessment: Given that the new global guidelines for country-based pooled funds were issued in December 2022, and that provisions were made to better deal with recurring critical risk findings for individual partners and to analyse key audit findings at the fund level to identify concrete actions, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
